blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Debates convince, but do not prove.
exercises.ru: Споры уверяют, ___ не удостоверяют.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom can remember the chords to the song, but can't remember all the lyrics.
exercises.ru: Том помнит аккорды песни, ___ не помнит слова.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: This is an old tub, not a car.
exercises.ru: Это корыто, ___ не машина.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: She tossed me grapes and I tried to catch them with my mouth.
exercises.ru: Она бросала мне виноградины, ___ я пытался поймать их ртом.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tea contains theine and coffee contains caffeine.
exercises.ru: В чае содержится теин, ___ в кофе - кофеин.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: But I have nothing left. I am just an old stump.
exercises.ru: ___ мне ничего не остаётся. Я всего лишь старый калека.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Jaime found the text quite difficult, but that didn't scare him off.
exercises.ru: Хайме текст показался довольно сложным, ___ это его не отпугнуло.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: It's not the volts that kill you, it's the amps.
exercises.ru: Убивает не напряжение, ___ ток.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Time is blind, man is stupid.
exercises.ru: Время слепо, ___ человек глуп.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The water was cold but invigorating.
exercises.ru: Вода была холодная, ___ бодрящая.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The outline is indistinct, but it looks like the silhouette of a man.
exercises.ru: Очертания неясные, ___ это похоже на силуэт человека.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Some friend you are.
exercises.ru: ___ ещё друг называется.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Passions weaken, but habits strengthen, with age.
exercises.ru: С возрастом страсти ослабевают, ___ привычки усиливаются.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: She isn't paid monthly, but daily.
exercises.ru: Ей платят не ежемесячно, ___ ежедневно.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: It's not a crocodile, it's a caiman.
exercises.ru: Это не крокодил, ___ кайман.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Most Shakuhachi are made from bamboo, but recently some wooden ones have appeared.
exercises.ru: Большинство сякухати делаются из бамбука, ___ недавно появились и деревянные.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Martino went all around the basement slowly, but didn't see anything strange at all.
exercises.ru: Мартино медленно обошёл весь цокольный этаж, ___ ничего странного не увидел.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: And you, how are you?
exercises.ru: ___ ты, как у тебя дела?
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Maria grew up in the DDR, which is why she learned Russian and not English.
exercises.ru: Мария выросла в ГДР, поэтому она учила русский, ___ не английский.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The box had been damaged, but its contents were intact.
exercises.ru: Коробка была повреждена, ___ её содержимое осталось нетронутым.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
